checkout.title: Almost airborne.
checkout.payWith: How would you like to pay?

online.title: Pay online now
online.body: Card, Apple Pay or Google Pay through SkipCash. Sessions land in your account the moment payment clears.

atStudio.title: Pay at the studio
atStudio.body: Reserve now, pay at the front desk by cash, card or SkipCash QR. Sessions are added once paid.
atStudio.bodyClass: Your spot is held until class starts. Pay at the front desk when you arrive.

checkout.phoneHint: SkipCash needs a mobile number for every payment. Qatari numbers can skip +974.
checkout.holdNote: We hold your spot for {minutes} minutes while you pay.
checkout.secure: Payments are processed by SkipCash. We never see or store your card details.
checkout.unavailable: This item isn't available to buy right now.
checkout.signInNote: You need a verified account so we can send your invoice and add the sessions to your account.

errors.phone_required: Please add a mobile number for SkipCash.
errors.method_unavailable: That payment option isn't available right now.
errors.payments_unavailable: Online payment isn't available right now. Please choose pay at the studio.
errors.payment_provider: SkipCash couldn't start the payment. Please try again in a moment.
errors.limit_reached: This offer is limited per customer, and you've already used it.
errors.unavailable: This item isn't available to buy right now.

errors.need_child: Kids classes are booked for a child.
errors.age: Outside the age range for this class.

errors.too_far: This class isn't open for booking yet.

errors.child_not_found: We couldn't find that child on your account.
errors.bad_request: Something was missing. Please try again.

paid.title: Payment received.
paid.body: Thank you. Your invoice is on its way to {email}.
paid.sessions: Your sessions are in your account.
paid.lateHold: The spot hold ended before your payment arrived, so the session is in your account. Book again from the timetable.

pending.title: Confirming your payment…
pending.body: This usually takes a few seconds. Keep this page open.

failed.title: Payment didn't go through.
failed.body: No money was taken. Try again, or pay at the studio instead.

atStudio.title: Reserved. Pay at the studio.
atStudio.body: Show this page at the front desk. Staff take cash, card, or SkipCash on your phone.
atStudio.held: Your spot is held until class starts.
atStudio.qrHint: Front desk scans this to find your order

cancelled.title: Order cancelled.
cancelled.body: This order is closed and nothing is owed.
